next.reason: 1985: '[ALL] LOW-VALUE(S) Except in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph, represents one or more of the character that has the lowest ordinal position in the program collating sequence' (§1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3); inside SPECIAL-NAMES it is the native sequence (§1985:VI.4.5.4 GR7). 2023 restates it: 'The character that has the lowest ordinal position in the program collating sequence is associated with the figurative constant LOW-VALUE, except when ... specified as a literal in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph' (§2023:12.3.7.4 GR9), and §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR7 ends 'otherwise, the alphanumeric program collating sequence is used'. The additions in GR7 (multiple-character combinations, LC_COLLATE locale, national program collating sequence, a runtime-determined sequence) arise only from locale-based alphabets, national contexts and a runtime change of the collating sequence, none of which a 1985 program can contain; LOW-VALUE means the same for a 1985 program.
